newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: HLG Capital to buy seats on exchange.
newsitem.headline: HLG Capital to buy seats on exchange.

text.p: HLG Capital Bhd said on Monday its unit HLG Futures Sdn Bhd had agreed to buy two seats on the Malaysia Monetary Exchange (MME) for a total of 1.15 million ringgit.
The MME trades interest rate futures and plans to eventually add trading in currency futures.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, HLG said the agreement was made with Harlow's (Malaysia) Sdn Bhd.
The proposed acquisition and the admission of HLG Futures as a broker member of the MME are subject to approval by the MME and the Securities Commission, it said.
